newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Travel Services started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Travel Services started.

text.p: Montgomery Securities on Monday said it initiated coverage of Travel Services International Inc with a rating of buy.
-- Analyst Micheal Moe said the shares have a 12- to 18-month price target of $30 a share.
-- Moe estimates Travel Services will report earnings of $0.33 per share when it releases its results next week. He estimates fiscal year 1997 earnings at $0.57 a share.
-- Moe said he sees the company is bringing "one-stop shopping" to the travel services industry by gathering specialty services from different travel segments under one roof.
